anchor: Which combat training gives me a small boost to how hard I am to hit, as long as I'm wearing any kind of protective gear?
My warrior wears a heavy plate suit and wants to be harder to hit; what feat needs a combat specialty already in place?
What magic trinket could whisk up to 199 willing companions into a private pocket realm where they heal and don't age?
After I use a magic scepter to hide my group in a pocket realm, how many days must pass before I can summon that refuge again?
Which hollow metal suit moves by itself, swings twice per turn, senses nearby things without eyes, and shrugs off toxins?
A clanking empty suit with almost no wits: can my rogue enchant, frighten, or freeze it with a spell, or is it protected from all of that?
At what druid level can I soar while in an animal form, and how many animal shapes can I know by then?
If my character transforms into an animal, does it keep its own memories and ability to speak, and what's the toughest creature it can pick at level four?
I'm going to explore a sunken shipwreck tomorrow. Is there a drink that lets me stay under the sea for a full day?
How would I recognize a murky green vial that smells of the ocean, has a pale bubble inside, and helps me breathe in the deep?
What tiny critter can both gulp air and paddle underwater, and leap about ten feet forward from a standstill?
My ranger wants a nearly harmless scout to send ahead: which tiny animal has just one hit point and sees in the dark?
Which small wild dog-like creature runs at forty feet per turn, sees in pitch darkness out to ninety feet, and bites weakly?
Which small creature has just 3 hit points, keen senses, and a knack for sneaking?
At what monk level can I scale walls and walk across lakes during my own turn, as long as I'm not in metal plating or carrying a defensive board?
My monk wants to cross a pond mid-fight without swimming or falling in. Which class ability does that, and does wearing chain mail rule it out?
Which sixth-level nature magic lets a creature step into a big tree and pop out of a far-off one, as long as I've laid eyes on that spot first?
Can I link two big woody growths across the same world for one minute, letting any creature slip through with only five feet of walking each?
Which mechanical rig has switches that extend legs for walking and swimming, and one that pushes out pincers from its front?
Inside a boxy walking machine, which control opens the side panels, and what does the front panel control do?
Which fancy garment has cloth swatches I can tear off to turn into a lantern, a rope, a ladder, or even a riding horse?
Is there a clothing piece that becomes a battering device, a rowboat, or a window I can place on a wall when I spend one action?
Which band of metal keeps rough, cluttered ground from costing me extra steps, and blocks magic from slowing me or freezing me in place?
Is there a jewelry piece that stops a hostile spell from cutting my speed or leaving me immobile, and does it need me to bond with it first?
Which cord can I flick at a foe up to 20 feet away to tie them up, forcing a reflex dodge roll of 15 to avoid the lash?
If something I've snared is wriggling out of my cord, what brawn or tumbling checks can it attempt, and how sturdy is the cord?
What pendant helps me avoid dying: when I'm on the brink and roll a 9 or lower on last-gasp rolls, it bumps that up to a 10?
Is there a necklace that doubles how much my recovery dice restore whenever I roll them to mend?
What level do martial characters reach when they can make three extra strikes whenever they take the attack action, and what milestone reward comes a level earlier?
At which level does a melee character gain a second use of an extra-action burst and a third chance to reroll a failed resist roll?
Which fifth-level spell lets me spy on and listen to a creature on my plane, where a lock of its hair makes it far easier to target?
Does peering at a stranger I've only heard rumors about through a glass orb make it easier or harder for them to resist?
Which huge neutral brute can hover in the air, hurl a booming bolt that leaves the victim unable to act until its next turn, and blink short distances?
My party faces a towering storm beast that can shroud the area in vapor at will and shape the weather once a day: what is its resistance DC?
Is there a combat training that counts any low damage die roll as a 3 when I hit with a heavy blade gripped in both hands?
Does a combat feat that upgrades low damage rolls to threes work with any blade or axe I hold in two hands, or only certain ones?
Which spell makes my outline shimmer so enemies have a harder time landing blows on me, but foes that sense me by vibration or see through illusions ignore it?
Which one-minute spell that needs only spoken words forces attackers to roll at a penalty against me?
Is there a knife with a plus-one bonus that I can coat with toxin for a minute, forcing a 15-difficulty hardiness roll on anyone it cuts?
If I dab a toxin on my blade, how long does it last, and when can I do it again?
At what level does a Champion-path warrior get to pick one more combat training feat of their choice?
My martial hero wants an extra combat-technique pick at seventh level. Which archetype grants it, and what kind of feat must I take?
When I'm sightless, do enemies get a bonus against me, and do my own strikes suffer a penalty?
If I'm sightless and try to spot a hidden trap in a room, does that check automatically fail, or can I still roll?
Which large neutral horror covered in tendrils can talk mind-to-mind, grabs medium foes, and whose bite drains maximum health after each long rest?
Which monster with 104 hit points can clutch a foe in its limbs and then crush everything it holds, leaving them dazed until its next turn?
What low-level magic attack hits from sixty feet with icy harm and gains extra dice at levels five, eleven, and seventeen?
Which chilling trick needs a ranged attack roll and leaves a foe moving slower until my own next turn comes around?
What second-level spell can I cast as a quick side action to make a plain sword a sharper tool for an hour, growing stronger with higher slots?
If I use a sixth-level slot to give my plain sword extra hitting power, how much bonus do I get, and what small piece of hide must I hold?
Which third-level spell creates a bright glow spreading over a sixty-foot sphere that also drives away lesser gloom spells within its area?
Can I cast radiance onto a small object I set down, then block it by covering it with a metal pot? How long does it last?
Which feature lets a wizard add their intellect bonus to one damage roll from any blasting spell, starting at level ten?
If my wizard's blast spell rolls several damage dice, does the intellect boost apply to each one or just one roll?
Which piece of jewelry gives me forty feet per turn of movement through lakes and seas?
Is there an uncommon trinket for moving through pools and rivers that doesn't need me to bond with it first?
Which polished gem nudges every skill test and resist roll I make up by one while I carry it?
Is there an uncommon small keepsake that requires me to bond with it before its bonus starts working?
Which wrapped-up dead creature is weak to fire, shrugs off life-draining harm and toxins, and whose punch curses its foe so they can't heal?
What decaying creature's stare terrifies a foe within sixty feet, and that victim is immune to the stare for a full day afterward?
At monk level ten, which three ailments can my willpower end at the close of each of my turns: being enchanted, being scared, or being toxin-sick?
Once I reach monk level ten, do I still get worn out from going without food or water on a long trek?
When I swing wildly in my fury state, does my first brawn-based hit each turn get extra harm from a handful of six-sided dice?
Do I deal the same kind of harm as my weapon when I go all-out in my wrathful state, and which hit gets the bonus?
What tiny aquatic animal can only breathe in water, and can zip its full swimming distance without drawing counterattacks?
Which pint-sized sea animal barely crawls on land at 5 feet per turn but swims 20 feet per turn?
Which fourth-level spell lets me jump up to 500 feet to any spot I can picture, and bring one friend standing right beside me?
If I try to warp myself into a spot already packed with a creature or solid objects, what harm do my group take and does the jump succeed?
Is there a fifth-level trick where I vanish and leave a copy I steer around with my own senses, and that nobody can touch or harm?
Does my concealment hold if I strike, hurt something, or cast a spell while my duplicate stands in view?
Which huge principled winged monster flies at eighty feet, shrugs off storm energy, and can shove foes sixty feet with a cone of wind?
How often per day can a big winged brute flip a failed resist roll into a success, and does its lair change that number?
Which fourth-level spell rains frozen chunks over a wide tube-shaped area up to 300 feet away, dealing both crushing and frigid harm?
When I use a fifth-level slot for my frozen-chunk spell, how much extra crushing harm does it add?
Starting at which level does my warrior first get to take a talent instead of raising base traits, and which later levels repeat that?
As a martial hero, can I pick any talent I qualify for at level 6 instead of a stat boost, and is that offered again at 16?
Which sixth-level nature spell raises a bramble barrier up to 120 feet away that blocks sight, and hurts anyone trying to push through it?
How much of my movement does slipping through a dense hedge of prickly shrubs cost, and how much harm does the first entry deal?
Which second-level spell can swell or shrink a creature by one step in build, giving the bigger one an edge on brawn tests and extra harm on weapon hits?
When I try to shrink an unwilling creature with a short-term size-change spell, what roll can it use to resist, and what happens to the things it drops?
